LIMA — This is the monthly guide for people who live in Lima or are staying for weeks, built around the things to do in Lima in December 2026. Prices are in soles with US dollar values at about S/3.47 to the dollar.

December opens with a crowded first week: two stadium concerts on the same night, a Kazakh pop star at Costa 21 and the start of the city ballet’s Christmas season. After that the month settles into conventions, anniversary shows and the big open-air music days before Christmas.

Key Facts Maná and Chayanne play Lima stadiums on Wednesday 2 December; Robbie Williams follows on 12 December.

The Jacksons play Costa 21 on Tuesday 15 December; BABYMETAL plays there on 7 December.

Public holidays: Tuesday 8, Wednesday 9 and Friday 25 December.

Prices are shown in soles with US$ values, at S/3.47 per US$1 (RT close, 25 November 2026).

Maná and Chayanne both play Lima stadiums on Wednesday 2 December, Robbie Williams follows on Saturday 12 December and The Jacksons arrive on Tuesday 15 December. The month, day by day.

Tuesday 8 and Wednesday 9 December are public holidays, and Christmas Day falls on a Friday, so plan for a long weekend at the end of the month.

Who is who: Teleticket, Joinnus and Ticketmaster are online ticket sellers, Wong and Metro are supermarket chains that also sell Ticketmaster tickets, and Interbank is a Peruvian bank whose card holders get early sales. Costa 21 is a concert hall in San Miguel, Estadio San Marcos and Estadio Nacional are big stadiums, and Cercado de Lima is the historic city centre.

Latin America Power Index · November 2026 edition Peru ranks 5th of 14 with 53.9 points. Strongest pillar: military means (71); weakest: future resources (37). Alignment group: Closer to Washington. See the full index, the business lens and the data →

Tribuna, Oriente and Occidente are stadium seating zones, and the Pentagonito is an auditorium in San Borja. Diario Correo, Caretas, Trome and Peru Informa are Peruvian news outlets, El Peruano is the official gazette, Infobae is a news site, Andina is the state news agency and KCH Comunicación is a press agency.

Legislative Decree 713 is Peru’s labour law on rest days, and RT is a financial data provider.

1 to 4 December: Stadiums and the Start of the Nutcracker

Tuesday 1 December Dimash Qudaibergen, Dimensions World Tour Multiespacio Costa 21, San Miguel · Tickets on Teleticket Diario Correo, a Lima daily, reported on 24 August 2026 that the Kazakh singer plays Costa 21, his first concert in Peru. Tickets are sold on Teleticket, and the start time and prices are not yet published here.

Wednesday 2 December Maná, Vivir Sin Aire Tour Estadio San Marcos, Cercado de Lima · S/184 to S/863 (about US$53 to US$249) The Mexican band plays its only Peru date on Wednesday 2 December, with sales on Teleticket from 18 June for Interbank card holders and from 22 June for everyone. Its price list runs from S/184 (US$53) in Tribuna Norte to S/863 (US$249) for the front rows, with Cancha 2 standing at S/288 (US$83). Start time not yet published.

Wednesday 2 December Chayanne, Bailemos Otra Vez Estadio Nacional, Lima · S/175 to S/725 (about US$50 to US$209) KCH Comunicación, a Lima press agency, said on 18 May 2026 that the Puerto Rican singer closes his world tour in Lima, the only city where he repeats a concert, and that tickets are sold through Ticketmaster, including its Wong and Metro stores. Its full-price list runs from S/175 (US$50) in Tribuna Norte to S/725 (US$209) in Platinum numbered seats, with Ticketmaster’s fee included. Start time not yet published.

Friday 4 to Sunday 27 December, 20 performances Cascanueces, Ballet Municipal de Lima Teatro Municipal de Lima, Jr. Ica 377, Cercado · From S/20 (about US$6) · Suitable for ages 2 and up Caretas, a Lima weekly magazine, reported on 30 October 2026 that the city’s own company stages The Nutcracker, with live orchestra and choir on six dates: Saturday 12 December at 18:00, Sunday 13 December at 18:00, Friday 18 December at 19:30, Saturday 19 December at 18:00, Wednesday 23 December at 19:30 and Friday 25 December at 18:00. Tickets are sold on Teleticket or at the theatre box office.

The First Weekend: 5 and 6 December

Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 December Perú Comic Con 2026, 5th edition Venue to be confirmed with the organiser · Tickets on Joinnus Andina, Peru’s state news agency, reported on 5 November 2026 that the pop-culture convention returns for its fifth edition with guests including Wilson Bethel, Nathan Kress, Jessie T. Usher and Drew Seeley. Tickets went on sale on Joinnus on 3 November, and prices are not yet published.

Sunday 6 December Jeanette, Tour 50 años Auditorio del Pentagonito, San Borja · Tickets on Teleticket El Peruano, the Peruvian government’s official gazette, reported on 1 November 2026 that the Spanish singer added a second show on Sunday 6 December after her first date sold out, as she celebrates 50 years on stage. Tickets are sold on Teleticket, and the start time is not yet published.

7 December: Metal and Chilean Rock

Monday 7 December BABYMETAL Multiespacio Costa 21, San Miguel · S/153 to S/282 (about US$44 to US$81) Infobae, a Latin American news site, reported on 14 April 2026 that the Japanese metal act plays a single Lima show on Monday 7 December. Its full prices were S/153 (US$44) for Campo B and S/282 (US$81) for Campo A, and presale was on Teleticket on 22 and 23 April.

Monday 7 December, 21:00 40 años Pateando Piedras, Miguel Tapia of Los Prisioneros Centro de Convenciones Barranco, Barranco El Peruano reported on 10 September 2026 that Tapia, the founding drummer of the Chilean band Los Prisioneros, plays at 21:00 to mark 40 years since the album Pateando Piedras. Prices and the ticket seller are not yet published.

12 December: Robbie Williams Closes His Tour

Saturday 12 December Robbie Williams Estadio San Marcos, Cercado de Lima · S/185 to S/585 (about US$53 to US$169) KCH Comunicación reported that the British singer’s show replaces the 24 September date at Arena 1 Park, which was suspended after the venue was shut, and that tickets for the original date stay valid. Its regular prices, on sale from 8 October, are S/185 (US$53) in Norte, S/371 (US$107) in Oriente, S/545 (US$157) in Occidente 1 and S/585 (US$169) in Occidente Central, sold through Ticketmaster and Wong stores. Start time not yet published.

15 December: The Jacksons

Tuesday 15 December The Jacksons Multiespacio Costa 21, San Miguel · S/198 to S/605 (about US$57 to US$174) Peru Informa, a Lima news site, reported that the group, led by original members Jackie and Marlon Jackson, plays its first Lima concert, with general-sale prices of S/198 (US$57) for standing, S/385 (US$111) for Zona ABC, S/495 (US$143) for Zona Jackson and S/605 (US$174) with a welcome drink, sold on Teleticket.

19 December: Rock and Salsa

19 December Rock Patrio Histórico II Anfiteatro del Parque de la Exposición, Cercado de Lima · Tickets on Teleticket Trome, a Lima tabloid daily, reported in late October 2026 that Peruvian rock fills the day with Mar de Copas, Amén, Río, LBD, Zen and Daniel F. The report calls 19 December a Friday, but the calendar says Saturday, and price and start time are not yet published.

Saturday 19 December, from 17:00 Trilogía de la Salsa 90s, 2nd edition Costa 21, San Miguel · 2×1 presale from S/75 (about US$22) · Ages 14 and over Diario Correo, a Lima daily, reported on 8 September 2026 that Teleticket lists a show of about six hours with Ex Salserín El Reencuentro, Ex Adolescentes El Reencuentro and Salsa Kids. The 2×1 presale prices, valid until 14 September, were S/75 (US$22) for the general stand, S/128 (US$37) for Tribuna Salsa, S/161 (US$46) for the VIP zone and S/199 (US$57) for Zona Salsa 90’s, fees included.

Planning Your Lima in December

El Peruano reported on 17 November 2026 that three national holidays fall this month: Tuesday 8 December (Immaculate Conception), Wednesday 9 December (Battle of Ayacucho) and Friday 25 December (Christmas). Anyone who works a holiday without a replacement day is paid a 100 per cent surcharge under Article 9 of Legislative Decree 713, and the 8th and 9th give two consecutive days off.

Stadium and arena shows finish late, and Costa 21 and the Costa Verde seafront are busy on concert nights, so arrange your ride home before you leave. Maná at Estadio San Marcos and Chayanne at Estadio Nacional share the night of Wednesday 2 December, so expect heavy traffic across the city.

Ticket sellers in this guide are Teleticket, Joinnus and Ticketmaster, so check accepted payment methods at checkout. Buy only from the official seller named on each card, because resale sites add fees and offer no guarantee.

Dollar values use RT’s Lima market close of S/3.4712 per US dollar on 25 November 2026. Check the seller’s page before you buy.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the public holidays in Lima in December 2026?

Tuesday 8 December is Immaculate Conception, Wednesday 9 December is the Battle of Ayacucho and Friday 25 December is Christmas, according to El Peruano on 17 November 2026. The 8th and 9th together give two consecutive days off.

How much are Robbie Williams tickets in Lima?

For the show at Estadio San Marcos on Saturday 12 December, regular tickets are S/185 (about US$53) in Norte, S/371 (US$107) in Oriente, S/545 (US$157) in Occidente 1 and S/585 (US$169) in Occidente Central, according to KCH Comunicación, a Lima press agency. They are sold through Ticketmaster and Wong stores.

Where can I see The Nutcracker in Lima in December?

The Ballet Municipal de Lima performs Cascanueces at Teatro Municipal de Lima from Friday 4 to Sunday 27 December, with tickets from S/20 (about US$6) on Teleticket or at the box office, according to Caretas on 30 October 2026. Six of the 20 performances have a live orchestra and choir.

Which big concerts are in Lima on 2 December 2026?

Maná plays Estadio San Marcos and Chayanne plays Estadio Nacional on Wednesday 2 December. Maná tickets are on Teleticket and Chayanne tickets are on Ticketmaster.

World.title: What to Do in Nairobi in December 2026: Fatboy Slim, Ferre Gola and SolFest
World.content:

NAIROBI — This is a monthly guide for people who live here or are staying for weeks, built around the dates, venues and ticket prices that ticket platforms and organisers list. It is your working list of things to do in Nairobi in December 2026.

December in Nairobi is a music month, and the busiest stretch is the Jamhuri Day weekend of 11 to 13 December. Jamhuri Day, on 12 December, is a national public holiday in Kenya, and it falls on a Saturday this year.

A second peak follows from 17 to 19 December, with SolFest, Jack White, Konshens and a late-night old-school party all in town.

Key Facts Fatboy Slim plays Friday 11 December at Hangar 16, Wilson Airport; Phase 5 costs US$38.

Ferre Gola headlines Saturday 12 December, Jamhuri Day, a public holiday, at Uhuru Gardens.

Sauti Sol’s SolFest runs 17 to 19 December, with Jack White playing on 18 December.

Prices are in US$ first, converted at about KES 130 per dollar (RT, 25 November 2026).

Fatboy Slim plays on 11 December, Ferre Gola headlines on Jamhuri Day, and Sauti Sol’s SolFest runs from 17 to 19 December. The month, day by day.

Prices below are in US$ first, with the Kenyan shilling (KES) price in brackets, converted at about KES 130 to the dollar (RT market data, 25 November 2026). Ticket platforms change prices in phases, so the figures show what the pages listed on 25 November.

Africa Intelligence One email, every weekday morning. African markets, politics and business — filed from our newsroom in Rio. Yesterday’s subject line: “Why the ships are heading back to Egypt” Get the brief

Who is who: Tikiti, Ticketsasa and Mookh are Kenyan online ticket platforms, and HustleSasa runs the SolFest and Jack White ticket stores. KODA is a Nairobi nightclub and events venue, and Hit Labzz is a studio on Muchai Drive.

Organisers named below are Hameco Limited Events (tree lighting), Glee Hotel Events (wine evening), Motic Africa (Mega Choma Battle), Talent Africa Group Kenya and Homeboyz Entertainment (Konshens), Back & Forth Ltd. (old-school party) and Bram Electronic Services (watch party). Indvstry Exchange is the music-industry event series behind the writing camp, summit concert and Music Summit.

Dala Festival is the banner for the Ferre Gola show, Zzero Sufuri headlines Amaplanka Live, and Enoo Napa is the DJ at KODA. KBC (Kenya Broadcasting Corporation) and K24, a Kenyan television news channel, are the outlets we cite.

4 to 6 December: The First Weekend

Friday 4 December, 6 to 10 pm Christmas Tree Lighting at Village Market Village Market, Limuru Road · Free entry (ticket on Ticketsasa) This is the easiest free way to start the festive season. Get the no-charge ticket on Ticketsasa, which lists the hosts as Hameco Limited Events.

Friday 4 December, 7 to 10 pm The Winemakers Table Glee Nairobi, Northern Bypass Road · US$62 (KES 8,000) A wine evening hosted by Glee Hotel Events. Ticketsasa lists a single ticket type, which closes at 7 pm on the night.

Friday 4 December Sondela Nairobi at KODA KODA Nairobi, nightclub and events venue KODA lists the night with Afrokillerz, Argento Dust, CheffK, Cleido, Ghedi, Hiribae, Siirski, Tina Ardor and Vidza on the bill. The KODA ticket page carries the booking link, so check it for prices and doors.

Saturday 5 December, 4 pm to 11:59 pm Back To Rock 5 Village Market, Limuru Road · Solo US$19 (KES 2,500), Couple US$35 (KES 4,500), Group of 3 US$46 (KES 6,000) A rock night at Village Market. The US$15 (KES 2,000) early-bird price closed on 5 November, and the other tickets close at 11:59 pm on the night.

Saturday 5 December Enoo Napa: Thirteen KE Residency, Night 3 KODA Nairobi Enoo Napa, a DJ, headlines a residency at KODA, with Caiiro, Culoe De Song, Foozak and Thandi Draai among the guests. KODA lists the 5 December date as the first of the final two shows, so check its ticket page for availability.

Saturday 5 to Sunday 6 December Amaplanka Live: The Takeover Homeboyz Entertainment Studios, Muchai Drive, off Ngong Road · Early Bird US$6 (KES 800), Regular US$9 (KES 1,200), VIP US$18 (KES 2,300) Tikiti lists an electronic and live-band showcase with a headline set by Zzero Sufuri, mixing Kenyan R&B, Afrobeats, gengetone and amapiano. The event text names the Hit Labzz studio while the venue field gives Homeboyz Entertainment Studios, both on Muchai Drive, so confirm the door before you travel. Tikiti showed only 20 VIP tickets left on 25 November.

Sunday 6 December, 2:00 to 4:00 pm Inspire Music Recital Homeboyz Entertainment Studios, Muchai Drive · US$8 (KES 1,000) A two-hour afternoon recital, a quiet option after the Saturday nightlife. Tickets are on Tikiti.

11 to 13 December: Jamhuri Weekend

Friday 11 December, 8 pm to 5 am MUZE Club presents Fatboy Slim Hangar 16, Wilson Airport · Phase 5 US$38 (KES 5,000); Phases 1 to 4 sold out The British big-beat DJ plays an all-night set organised by MUZE Club, an electronic music promoter. Mookh, the ticket platform, lists the night from 8 pm to 5 am, and its event text says the venue moved to Hangar 16 at Wilson Airport, while the venue field still shows an older name. A K24 report of 11 September described the show at the Muze club, so rely on the Mookh description. Phase 5 is the last tier listed.

Friday 11 December Enoo Napa: Thirteen KE Residency, Night 4 KODA Nairobi The residency closes with its fourth night, again with Caiiro, Culoe De Song and Foozak. KODA lists this date as the final show.

Saturday 12 December, 10 am to 6 pm Kenya Mega Choma Battle 2026 KICC, city centre · Advance single US$8 (KES 1,000), Group of 3 US$18 (KES 2,400) Choma means grilled, and nyama choma is Kenya’s roast-meat tradition, so this is a daytime food contest hosted by Motic Africa at the Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC). Ticketsasa closes sales at 11:59 pm on Friday 11 December.

Saturday 12 December, 3 pm, to Sunday 13 December, 4 am Ferre Gola Live in Nairobi (Dala Festival) Uhuru Gardens, Nairobi · Regular US$38 (KES 5,000), VIP US$77 (KES 10,000), VVIP US$192 (KES 25,000) Ferre Gola is a Congolese rumba singer, and this show lands on Jamhuri Day. Mookh also sells tables, at US$769 (KES 100,000) for four and US$1,538 (KES 200,000) for eight, with payment in up to two instalments. The Mookh page shows 3 pm at the top and 12 noon in the ticket section, so confirm the start time.

Saturday 12 December, 4 pm, to Sunday 13 December, 4 am KENYA @63: Something For The Bunnies Simba Saloon, Carnivore Nairobi · Advance US$15 (KES 2,000), VIP US$92 (KES 12,000) A Jamhuri Day party at Carnivore Nairobi, running through to Sunday morning. Tikiti lists the two ticket types above.

Saturday 12 December, 6 pm, to Sunday 13 December, midnight Masquerade Prom 26 Tribe Hotel, Limuru Road · Individual US$46 (KES 6,000), Couples US$81 (KES 10,500) A prom-style night at the Tribe Hotel. Early-bird prices of US$35 (KES 4,500) for individuals and US$62 (KES 8,000) for couples were also listed on Mookh.

12 to 14 December: Indvstry Exchange

Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 December Indvstry Exchange: Writing Camp, Days 1 and 2 Hit Labzz Studios, 735 Muchai Drive, off Ngong Road · Invite only, approval required (Tikiti listing) Two writing-camp days at the studio. Tikiti lists them as free but invite only, with approval required and no RSVP available, so they are not open to the public.

Monday 14 December, 7 pm to midnight Indvstry Exchange: Summit Concert Hit Labzz Studios, 735 Muchai Drive, off Ngong Road · Early Bird US$8 (KES 1,000), Standard US$12 (KES 1,500), Gate US$15 (KES 2,000) Tikiti describes five hours of live music. The date is a Monday, and Tikiti shows only 20 early-bird tickets left on 25 November.

Monday 14 December Indvstry Exchange: Music Summit Hit Labzz Studios, 735 Muchai Drive, off Ngong Road · Early Bird US$12 (KES 1,500), Standard US$19 (KES 2,500), Final Release US$27 (KES 3,500), Silver US$30 (KES 3,900), Gold US$62 (KES 8,000) The summit is listed for the same day as the concert. Tikiti lists no start time.

17 to 20 December: SolFest and the Late-month Shows

Thursday 17 to Saturday 19 December SolFest 2026 (Sauti Sol) VIP Show on Thursday, Safari Oontz on Friday, Fan Show on Saturday · Tickets on the SolFest store on HustleSasa The Kenyan band Sauti Sol runs the festival, which KBC reported on 3 June 2026 as running from 17 December (VIP show) to 19 December (Fan Show), with the new electronic day Safari Oontz on 18 December. Check the SolFest store for current prices.

Friday 18 December Jack White Masshouse, Ngong Racecourse · Tickets on HustleSasa The American rock singer plays Masshouse at Ngong Racecourse. Tickets are on the jackwhite.hustlesasa.shop page, which lists the date and venue.

Friday 18 December Dancehall Detention with Konshens Sarit Expo Centre, Westlands · Regular US$38 (KES 5,000), VIP US$77 (KES 10,000) The Jamaican dancehall star plays the Sarit Expo Centre in Westlands, presented by Talent Africa Group Kenya with Homeboyz Entertainment. The Tikiti page is strictly 18 and over, lists no start time, and says tickets are non-refundable.

Friday 18 December BPM Trap House Alloy Bar & Lounge, Sarit Centre · Advance US$17 (KES 2,222) and US$21 (KES 2,777), Gate US$27 (KES 3,555), VIP US$38 (KES 5,000) A trap and house night with two stages, handy if the Konshens show is not your style. The US$12 (KES 1,555) early-bird tier is sold out, and the VIP ticket adds House backstage and Trap balcony access.

Saturday 19 December, 3 pm, to Sunday 20 December, 4 am BACK & FORTH Old School Party Simba Saloon, Carnivore · Advance US$15 (KES 2,000), Gate US$19 (KES 2,500) An old-school music party hosted by Back & Forth Ltd. on Ticketsasa. The advance price closes at 11:59 am on Friday 18 December, and gate sales open at midnight into the day itself.

Sunday 20 December The Ultimate Rivalry Watch Party KICC Courtyard, city centre · Regular US$27 (KES 3,500), Group of 2 US$46 (KES 6,000), VIP US$77 (KES 10,000) The organiser’s listing says Sunday 20 December for a big-screen watch party for the Arsenal and Manchester United match, hosted by Bram Electronic Services, with food, drinks and a concert after the final whistle. The Regular ticket includes two drinks and a seat, and the VIP ticket adds four drinks, a platter and a lounge. Tikiti lists no kick-off time.

Planning Your Nairobi in December

Jamhuri Day falls on Saturday 12 December, Christmas Day on Friday 25 December and Boxing Day on Saturday 26 December, according to the schedule of the Public Holidays Act published by Kenya’s Interior ministry. Tickets are sold through Tikiti, Mookh, Ticketsasa and HustleSasa, so check each page’s payment options before you buy.

Mookh lets you pay the Ferre Gola tables in up to two instalments.KODA Nairobi’s ticket page lists more nights beyond those above, including Temple Nairobi on 28 November and Friends of Mongoma on 27 November, which fall before this guide’s month begins. Check it for dates added in December.

Many venues sit on Ngong Road, in Lang’ata or in Westlands, and several shows end at 4 or 5 am. Arrange your ride home before a late finish.

The exchange rate used here is about KES 130 to the US dollar (RT, 25 November 2026). Ticket prices were read from the platforms on 25 November 2026 and can change.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the biggest events in Nairobi in December 2026?

Fatboy Slim plays on Friday 11 December, and Sauti Sol’s SolFest runs from Thursday 17 to Saturday 19 December. Ferre Gola headlines the Dala Festival on Jamhuri Day, Saturday 12 December.

When are the public holidays in Nairobi this December?

Jamhuri Day is Saturday 12 December, Christmas Day is Friday 25 December and Boxing Day is Saturday 26 December.

How much are tickets for Fatboy Slim in Nairobi?

Phases 1 to 4 are sold out, and Phase 5 costs US$38 (KES 5,000) on Mookh. The show runs from 8 pm on Friday 11 December to 5 am on Saturday.

Which December events in Nairobi are free?

The Christmas Tree Lighting at Village Market on Friday 4 December lists free tickets on Ticketsasa.

World.title: What to Do in Tulum in December 2026: Innovation Fest, Gitano Jungle and Zamna NYE

TULUM — This is the monthly guide for people who live in Tulum or are staying for weeks, covering things to do in Tulum in December 2026. Every listing below has a December 2026 date, a venue and a ticket seller, taken from its page on Ticket Fairy.

December here is mostly nightlife, one large tech conference and a long run of New Year’s Eve parties. Most of the venues sell tickets in Mexican pesos, so we show the US dollar value first, converted at the Banxico (Mexico’s central bank) rate of about 18.55 pesos to the dollar on 13 November 2026.

Key Facts Tulum Innovation Fest runs 9 to 12 December at IKAL Arena; a four-day pass costs US$213.

Zamna, an electronic-music brand, runs six nights from 31 December; Multipass from US$425.

New Year’s Eve parties fill 31 December at Vesica, Gitano and other Tulum venues.

Prices are in US$ first, converted from pesos; confirm each date at checkout.

Tulum Innovation Fest runs from 9 to 12 December, Gitano Jungle marks its anniversary on 18 December, and Renaissance brings Sasha and Maceo Plex to a New Year’s Eve party. The month, day by day.

Several parties offer a cheaper local ticket for residents of Tulum or Quintana Roo, the state that contains Tulum. Bring valid ID, because the organisers say they check it at the door.

Who is who: Ticket Fairy is the online ticket seller used for almost every event below. Gitano Jungle, Papaya Playa and Vesica are Tulum beach and jungle clubs, and Zamna is an electronic-music festival brand. Ley Federal del Trabajo is Mexico’s Federal Labour Law, which sets the public rest days.

Latin America Power Index · November 2026 edition Mexico ranks 2nd of 14 with 70.8 points. Strongest pillar: economic relationships (90); weakest: state capacity & security (46). Alignment group: Hedging. Watch21 homicides per 100,000; organised crime at 7.7 of 10. See the full index, the business lens and the data →

4 to 10 December: The First Week

Friday 4 December, 6:00 PM Gypsy Disco at Gitano Jungle Gitano Jungle, Boca Paila Km 7.5 · General admission US$43 (MXN 800), including a welcome drink · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 The Friday party at Gitano Jungle starts at 6:00 PM and runs until 3:30 AM. Ticket Fairy lists open-bar packages from US$83 (MXN 1,540) for two hours and VIP tables up to US$1,455 (MXN 27,000). The same night returns on Friday 11 December at the same time, with general admission at US$43 (MXN 800).

Saturday 5 December, 9:00 PM Papaya Playa Project presents The New Moon Papaya Playa Project · General admission US$119 (MXN 2,200); early entrance before 10:00 PM US$95 (MXN 1,760); Tulum residents with a valid INE voter card US$77 (MXN 1,430) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 Papaya Playa Project, a beachfront hotel and event venue, runs this themed Saturday night until 3:00 AM. Ticket Fairy says doors open at 8:00 PM, and a Mayan dinner sitting at 8:00 PM costs US$178 (MXN 3,300).

Thursday 10 December, 7:30 PM Las Gitanas at Gitano Jungle Gitano Jungle, Boca Paila Km 7.5 · Guest list free; open bar for one hour US$42 to US$53 (MXN 770 to 990); dinner and dancing US$145 (MXN 2,695) · 18+ · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 The free guest list is the cheapest way into Gitano, and the night runs until 3:30 AM on Friday. Ticket Fairy lists the same Thursday night again on 17 December, so check each date’s own page before you buy.

9 to 12 December: Tulum Innovation Fest

Wednesday 9 to Saturday 12 December, from 4:00 PM on the 9th Tulum Innovation Fest 2026: The New Economy Edition IKAL Arena · Community Access for Tulum residents (50% off) US$107 (MXN 1,980); General Access, 4-day pass US$213 (MXN 3,960); Executive Pass US$1,572 (MXN 29,160) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 This is the month’s main event, a four-day technology conference. The organiser says it ends at 11:30 PM on Saturday 12 December and includes talks, panels and official parties. Residents need valid proof of local residency at check-in, and the discount excludes the VIP areas and the cocktail gala.

Saturday 12 December, 9:00 PM Papaya Playa Project presents Starlight Papaya Playa Project · General admission US$119 (MXN 2,200); early entrance before 10:00 PM US$89 (MXN 1,650); Tulum residents US$77 (MXN 1,430) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 This Starlight Saturday falls on the last day of the Innovation Fest and ends at 3:00 AM on Sunday. It suits anyone finishing the conference who wants a night out afterwards.

18 and 19 December

Friday 18 December, 6:00 PM Gitano Jungle Anniversary / Gitano Festival Gitano Jungle, Boca Paila Km 7.5 · General admission US$68 (MXN 1,265); Quintana Roo residents with valid ID US$30 (MXN 550); open bar US$273 (MXN 5,060) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 Gitano marks its anniversary with a festival-style Friday that runs until 3:30 AM on Saturday. Ticket Fairy shows no line-up, so check the page for announcements before buying.

Saturday 19 December, 9:00 PM Papaya Playa Project presents The New Moon Papaya Playa Project · General admission US$119 (MXN 2,200); Tulum residents US$77 (MXN 1,430) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 The New Moon theme returns for the Saturday before Christmas week and ends at 3:00 AM on Sunday. Ticket Fairy lists it on 19 December, so confirm the date at checkout.

Christmas Weekend

Saturday 26 December, 9:00 PM Papaya Playa Project presents The Full Moon Papaya Playa Project · General admission early bird US$113 (MXN 2,090); Tulum residents US$77 (MXN 1,430) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 This night comes the day after Christmas and ends at 3:00 AM on Sunday. Ticket Fairy lists it on 26 December, so confirm the date at checkout.

Thursday 31 December: New Year’s Eve

Thursday 31 December, 10:00 PM Renaissance Tulum NYE UX Arena, Chemuyil, Quintana Roo · General Admission early bird US$109.50; VIP early bird US$236.00 · 18+ · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 The line-up is Sasha, Maceo Plex, Sébastien Léger and Ida Engberg, with further headliners to be announced. Ticket Fairy lists a lower price of US$90 for General Admission excluding fees, so check the checkout total.

Thursday 31 December 2026 to Sunday 10 January 2027 Zamna Tulum season Zamna Tulum · Multipass from US$425 · Zamna Festival website, retrieved 25 November 2026 Zamna, an electronic-music festival brand, runs a six-night Tulum season from 31 December 2026 to 10 January 2027. Beatportal, an electronic-music news site, reported on 4 November that the season marks the brand’s tenth anniversary and that a Multipass covers any three nights. Only the first night falls in this guide’s month.

Thursday 31 December, 6:00 PM Papaya Playa Project New Year’s Eve 2026 to 2027 Papaya Playa Project · General Admission early bird US$253 (MXN 4,697); Tier 1 US$308 (MXN 5,720) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 The earliest start among the big New Year’s Eve parties is 6:00 PM, and the event ends at 6:30 AM on 1 January. Ticket Fairy names no performers, only electronic music, live acts and art.

Thursday 31 December, 7:00 PM Nômade Temple Tulum and Be Destination NYE Nômade, Tulum · Party only, early bird US$249 (MXN 4,620); dinner and party, early bird US$534 (MXN 9,900) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 The dinner ticket includes an open bar from 7:30 PM to 11:00 PM and a glass of sparkling wine for the midnight toast. The organisers say the line-up is not yet announced, and all sales are final.

Thursday 31 December, dinner tiers from 7:30 PM NYE at Vesica Tulum: Expect the Impossible Vesica Tulum / Cenote Club · Party US$89 (MXN 1,650); dinner, show and party US$231 (MXN 4,290); party with open bar US$184 (MXN 3,410) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 A New Year’s Eve party at a cenote club, a natural limestone sinkhole filled with fresh water. It ends at 3:00 AM on 1 January, and Ticket Fairy lists no performers.

Thursday 31 December, 8:00 PM White Party Tulum 2027 at Ahau Tulum Ahau Tulum, Carretera Tulum a Boca Paila Km 7.5 · Early bird party only US$285 (MXN 5,280); early bird dinner and party US$415 (MXN 7,700); locals party only US$225 (MXN 4,180) · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 Dinner starts at 8:00 PM and the party at 10:00 PM, hosted by Ahau Collection, curated by David Graziano, the founder of Ahau, and produced by SET Underground, an events company. The dress code is “Tribal White Chic Attire”, which the listing says is strictly enforced.

Thursday 31 December, 8:00 PM NYE 2027 at Gitano Jungle Gitano Jungle, Boca Paila Km 7.5 · Quintana Roo residents US$102 (MXN 1,897.50); general admission with open bar US$239 (MXN 4,427.50) · 18+ · Ticket Fairy, retrieved 25 November 2026 Gitano’s own New Year’s Eve starts at 8:00 PM and runs until 3:00 AM. Ticket Fairy mentions international DJs and a live cabaret show but names no artists.

Planning Your Tulum in December

Friday 25 December and Friday 1 January 2027 are mandatory rest days under Article 74 of Mexico’s Federal Labour Law, as the labour-rights agency Profedet explains for 2026. Expect some businesses to close on both days.

Most tickets here are sold through Ticket Fairy, and Zamna also sells on its own website. Ticket Fairy shows prices in pesos for the Mexican venues and in US dollars for Zamna.

Gitano Jungle and Ahau Tulum both give their address as Boca Paila Km 7.5, on the coastal road south of the town. Renaissance is listed at UX Arena in Chemuyil, a separate location, so arrange your ride home before you go, especially on New Year’s Eve.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the biggest event in Tulum in December 2026?

Tulum Innovation Fest runs from Wednesday 9 to Saturday 12 December at IKAL Arena. The 4-day General Access pass is US$213 (MXN 3,960).

Do Tulum residents get a discount on Innovation Fest?

Yes. Community Access is 50% off for Tulum residents with proof of residency, at US$107 (MXN 1,980).

What is the cheapest night out at Gitano Jungle?

The Las Gitanas guest list on Thursday 10 December is free, subject to availability, for ages 18 and over. Ticket Fairy also lists it on 17 December.

Where is the Renaissance New Year’s Eve party and what does it cost?

Renaissance Tulum NYE is at UX Arena in Chemuyil, Quintana Roo, from 10:00 PM on 31 December. Early-bird General Admission is US$109.50 and VIP is US$236.00 on Ticket Fairy.

DURBAN — This is our monthly guide for people who live in the city or are staying for weeks, covering things to do in Durban in December 2026. Every event below has a date, a venue and a way to get in, checked against the organiser, venue or ticket page on 25 November 2026.

Sean Paul plays on 6 December, the light shows open from 9 December, and Anywhere fills Moses Mabhida People’s Park on 19 and 20 December. Gagasi FM Beach Fest is on 5 December at the same park, although its Ticketpro page showed it sold out, and 16 December (Day of Reconciliation), 25 December and 26 December are public holidays.

Key Facts Sean Paul plays the Durban ICC on 6 December, the city’s convention centre.

The Trail of Lights opens 9 December; Anywhere Festival follows on 19 and 20 December.

Three public holidays fall in the month: 16, 25 and 26 December.

Prices are in US$ first, converted from rand at R17.55 per dollar (RT, 25 November).

Sean Paul plays the Durban ICC on 6 December, the Botanic Gardens Trail of Lights opens on 9 December and Anywhere Festival fills Moses Mabhida People’s Park on 19 and 20 December. The month, day by day.

Who is who: Webtickets, Quicket, Howler, Ticketpro and Blu Blood Tickets are South African online ticket sellers, and Time Out Durban is a city listings magazine. The ICC is Durban’s International Convention Centre, UKZN is the University of KwaZulu-Natal, and the Playhouse Company runs the city’s main theatres. Day of Goodwill is the public holiday on 26 December, and R is the South African rand, converted at the RT market-data rate.

1 to 6 December: Cinderella, ELF, Beach Fest and Sean Paul

Friday 4 December, 11:00 schools’ performance (runs 3 December to 10 January 2027) Cinderella (pantomime) Elizabeth Sneddon Theatre, UKZN Howard College campus, Mazisi Kunene Road · US$11 to US$18 (R185 to R310) This is a family theatre run over the festive season, and Webtickets lists shows on Saturday 5 December at 11:00 and 15:30 and Sunday 6 December at 14:30. There are no performances from 24 December to 1 January.

Friday 4 December, market from 16:00, film from 19:30 Park Square Christmas Market and Movie Night Park Square, Umhlanga · Free entry Park Square’s events page lists a family-friendly film that starts around 19:30. The title is still to be announced, so check the centre’s social media pages.

Friday 4 December (runs to Sunday 20 December), mostly 14:30 ELF The Musical Jr Playhouse Company, Drama Theatre, 231 Anton Lembede Street, Durban Central · From US$11 (R190), up to US$13 (R225) Webtickets lists most shows at 14:30. Extra shows run at 11:00 on 5, 8, 12, 16 and 19 December and at 18:30 on 11 and 18 December.

Saturday 5 December, gates 10:00 to midnight Gagasi FM Beach Fest (13th edition) Moses Mabhida People’s Park, 44 Isaiah Ntshangase Road, Durban · General access US$23 (R400), VIP US$57 (R1,000) Ticketpro lists these prices but showed the event as sold out on 25 November, with no tickets sold at the door. It says tickets may become available again, so check the page before you travel.

Sunday 6 December, doors 18:00, show 20:00 Sean Paul live Durban ICC, 45 Bram Fischer Road, central Durban · From US$54 (R950); sold-out Silver tier was US$43 (R750) Blu Blood Tickets calls Durban the final date of his South Africa tour and the only KwaZulu-Natal show. Its Black Friday prices are Gold Seated US$54 (R950), Diamond US$56 (R990), Platinum US$77 (R1,350) and Golden Seated US$103 (R1,800).

9 to 13 December: Lights and Carols

Wednesday 9 December, 18:00 and 19:30 slots (to Saturday 2 January 2027) Durban Botanic Gardens Trail of Lights, 10th anniversary Durban Botanic Gardens, John Zikhali Road · US$3 to US$5 (R50 to R95) · Children 2 and under free This is the city’s main light show, and Webtickets says you can enter at any time after your start time. Time Out Durban reported on 28 October that tickets cost from US$5 (R85) online and US$7 (R120) at the gate, and are also sold at Pick n Pay and Boxer.

Wednesday 9 December, 18:00 to 21:00 Carols by Candlelight, The Oyster Box Ocean Terrace, The Oyster Box, Umhlanga · US$80 (R1,400) per person, US$40 (R700) for children under 12 Time Out Durban listed this evening on 18 November with the Durban Symphonic Choir. Time Out Durban is the only source we found, so confirm the date and price with the hotel before you book.

Thursday 10 December, 06:30 to 07:30 (tour runs to 20 December) Wake & Shake Coffee Rave Tour Now Coffee, 11 Park Avenue, Umhlanga · US$6 (R100); early bird sold out · Children under 6 free uTickets lists the Umhlanga stop as an early-morning dance session over coffee. Time Out Durban lists the wider tour as 11 stops between 10 and 20 December.

Friday 11 December (Camp Orchards) and Saturday 12 December (Chris Saunders Park), to Monday 28 December Lights in the Park Camp Orchards, Hillcrest, and Chris Saunders Park, Umhlanga · US$4 to US$5 (R70 to R80) Webtickets lists Camp Orchards from 11 to 22 December and Chris Saunders Park from 12 to 28 December. Opening hours are not shown on the booking page, so check them at checkout.

Sunday 13 December, 14:00 (repeat on Wednesday 16 December, 14:00) André Rieu’s Christmas Concert screening: Let It Snow Rhumbelow Theatre, Cunningham Road, Durban · US$11 (R185) Webtickets lists two cinema-style screenings of the Dutch violinist’s 2026 Christmas concert. Doors open 90 minutes before each show.

15 to 20 December: Reconciliation Week and Anywhere Festival

Tuesday 15 December, gates 17:00, concert 19:15 to 21:30 One Night One Hope Fig Tree Farm, 57 Inanda Road, Hillcrest · Adults US$13 (R220), children 12 and under US$6 (R110), under 3 free Quicket lists a Christmas concert with gates at 17:00 and parking at US$1 (R20) a car. It is far cheaper than the hotel dinners, so arrive early to settle in before the music.

Wednesday 16 December, 18:00 to 21:00, film at 19:00 Outdoor Cinema 031: The Grinch Who Stole Christmas Sugar Rush Park, Ballito · Quicket lists free options; tickets are limited This is an open-air screening of the 2000 Jim Carrey film on the North Coast, on the evening of the Day of Reconciliation public holiday. Time Out Durban reported adult tickets at US$5 (R80) and children at US$3 (R50), so check the final price at checkout.

Saturday 19 and Sunday 20 December, 12:00 to midnight Anywhere Festival (Season 10) Moses Mabhida People’s Park, Durban · Day tickets US$14 to US$71 (R250 to R1,250), two-day pass US$23 to US$120 (R400 to R2,100) Webtickets says each day has its own line-up, but no artists are named yet. Time Out Durban lists the event as 18+, with paid parking on site, no camping and no outside food or drink.

Saturday 19 December, 12:00 to 22:00 Corona Sunsets Summer Tour: Ballito Manor House, Sheffield Beach, Ballito · Prices not listed on the Howler page Howler lists this daytime beach event as on sale now and closed to under-18s. Check the ticket page for the line-up and price.

27 to 31 December: New Year’s Eve

Sunday 27 to Wednesday 30 December Big Week 2026: Homecoming Kingsmead Stadium Outer Field, 10 Kingsmead Way, Stamford Hill · From US$14 (R250) The organiser lists a Loyalty ticket from US$14 (R250), a one-night BIG Ticket from US$16 (R280) and a four-day BIG Pass from US$85 (R1,500). A booking fee applies at checkout.

Thursday 31 December, 14:00 to midnight 031 NYE Kings Park outer fields, Durban · US$14 to US$66 (R250 to R1,150) Webtickets lists general tickets and pass combos for the New Year’s Eve party beside the stadium. The page gives only the overall price range.

Thursday 31 December, 15:00 to 02:00 Summerdaze NYE Durban Beachwood Beach, Beachwood Place, Durban North · General admission US$14 (R250); six-ticket group deal US$68 (R1,200) uTickets lists a neon-lit beach stage, South African DJs and midnight fireworks. The group deal works out at US$11 (R200) a head, and the early-bird tier has sold out.

Planning Your Durban in December

Dollar amounts in this guide use about R17.55 to the dollar, the RT market rate on 25 November 2026. Ticket prices change, so treat each figure as the price on the day we checked.

South Africa’s government lists three public holidays this month: Wednesday 16 December (Day of Reconciliation), Friday 25 December (Christmas Day) and Saturday 26 December (Day of Goodwill). Expect shorter shop hours and busier roads around those dates.

The Trail of Lights is themed “10 Years of Wonder”, according to Time Out Durban on 28 October. New this year are a Tree of Wonder, two food gardens, live entertainment, a Santa’s Village, ziplines and a rhino conservation display.

Webtickets shows no Trail of Lights time slots on 25 and 31 December. Time Out Durban also lists Paws ‘n Claus nights on 10 or 14 December, when dogs may enter for R60 (US$3) each.

Anywhere Festival and the Gagasi FM Beach Fest both use Moses Mabhida People’s Park, so plan your ride home before you go. Both are for adults only, according to Time Out Durban.

Most tickets in this guide are sold on Webtickets, Quicket, Howler, uTickets and Ticketpro, while Sean Paul tickets are sold through Blu Blood Tickets. Some events can sell out, so check availability first.

If you want a New Year’s Eve dinner instead, Time Out Durban lists A Golden Midnight at FireLake in the Radisson Blu Hotel Durban Umhlanga on 31 December from 18:00 to 02:00. It costs US$123 (R2,150) per person, children under 12 pay half, and you reserve by email because there is no ticket platform.

For events not listed here, watch Time Out Durban and the official Durban tourism listings.

Frequently Asked Questions

When does the Durban Trail of Lights run in 2026?

It runs from Wednesday 9 December 2026 to Saturday 2 January 2027 at the Durban Botanic Gardens, with time slots at 18:00 and 19:30. Webtickets lists R50 to R95 (US$3 to US$5), while Time Out Durban quotes R120 (US$7) at the gate.

Where can I see Sean Paul in Durban?

He plays the Durban ICC on Sunday 6 December, the last date of his South Africa tour. Blu Blood Tickets lists seats from R950 (US$54) to R1,800 (US$103), and the cheapest Silver tier is sold out.

Which days are public holidays in Durban in December 2026?

Wednesday 16 December is the Day of Reconciliation, Friday 25 December is Christmas Day and Saturday 26 December is the Day of Goodwill.

What is on in Durban on New Year’s Eve 2026?

On Thursday 31 December there are 031 NYE at Kings Park (R250 to R1,150, or US$14 to US$66) and Summerdaze at Beachwood Beach (from R250, or US$14). Time Out Durban also lists a dinner at FireLake in Umhlanga (R2,150, or US$123, per person).

World.title: Mauritius Jury Clears Man Accused of Murder
World.content:
Mauritius · Courts

A jury in Mauritius found Jean Brandon Joli not guilty of murder on Thursday 26 November 2026, by seven votes to two, Defimedia, a Mauritian news site, reported that evening. The verdict came at the assize court (Cour d’assises), a trial by jury held in the Supreme Court in Port Louis, the capital.

Joli, who lives in the village of Camp-Levieux, had been accused of killing his employer, the entrepreneur Reddy Mooneesawmy, at the man’s home in Stanley, a suburb of the town of Rose-Hill, in late May 2022. Mauritius is an Indian Ocean island nation, and nine jurors were chosen by lottery for this case, L’Express, a Mauritian daily, reported on 10 November.

Key Facts Who. Jean Brandon Joli, a Mauritian, cleared of murdering his employer, entrepreneur Reddy Mooneesawmy.

What. Jury acquitted him by seven votes to two; no reasons given in reports.

Where. Assize court, Supreme Court, Port Louis, Mauritius; the killing was in Stanley.

When. Thursday 26 November 2026; the crime dates from late May 2022.

As of 26 November 2026, 22:30 GMT

A Mauritian jury cleared a man of murdering his employer in 2022. The reasons for its decision have not been reported.

Follow this story Get an email when there’s news on Mauritius Email address Follow

Jurors retired at about 15:45 after the judge, Mehdi Manrakhan, gave his closing instructions. Defimedia’s report, published at 19:43, said they returned a not-guilty verdict.

L’Express’s website listed a story headed “Jean Brandon Adolphe Joli acquitté” on 26 November. We could not open the text of its verdict report, so this article takes the vote count from Defimedia alone.

Port Louis, the capital of Mauritius, where the Supreme Court sits. File photo of the Blue Penny Museum, Rio Times library.

Ask Open the full Ask Rio Times →

The prosecution, led by Anjaleedevi Ramdin, the deputy head of the state prosecution service, alleged a robbery gone wrong, Defimedia said. It argued that Joli, who had worked as a mason for the victim, was surprised while allegedly trying to burgle him.

Africa Intelligence One email, every weekday morning. African markets, politics and business — filed from our newsroom in Rio. Yesterday’s subject line: “Why the ships are heading back to Egypt” Get the brief

On 12 November L’Express reported that prosecutors said the victim had drunk a lot of alcohol and shouted “Voler!” (Thief!) on surprising an intruder. They said he was grabbed from behind, dragged to his bedroom and smothered face down against the mattress, dying within seconds.

The same report said prosecutors pointed to DNA traces in several places, including the bedroom door handle, as well as hair on the floor and fingerprints on a television and a whisky bottle. A bloodstained pillow, probably the victim’s, was presented in court on the second day of the trial, Wednesday 11 November, L’Express added.

L’Express names the victim as Reddy Mooneesawmy, while Defimedia gives his first name as Soopramanien. L’Express gives Saturday 28 May 2022 as the date, whereas Defimedia puts the killing on 27 May.

Seven suspects, all employees of the victim, were questioned in 2022 and denied involvement, L’Express reported on 10 November. Their phones were seized.

Joli was arrested in August 2022, about three months after the killing, by police detectives from Stanley and a police intelligence unit for the west of the island, according to L’Express, which added that, per information published in 2022, he was said to have confessed. He pleaded not guilty, the jury acquitted him, and the judge told jurors that statements attributed to him held no explicit admission of intent to kill.

In his closing instructions to jurors, Judge Manrakhan said criminal intent can be inferred from circumstances, Defimedia said. He added that the statements attributed to Joli, central to the prosecution case, contained no explicit admission of intent to kill.

Defence lawyer Neelkanth Dulloo represented Joli. After the verdict Joli told Defimedia in Creole, “Mo byin kontan” (I am very happy), and in French, “Je reconstruirai ma vie” (I will rebuild my life).

The reports do not say why the jury acquitted. Nor do they say whether the prosecution can or will challenge the verdict.

Reports also do not say how long Joli was held or whether anyone else is under investigation. No next court date has been reported.

Frequently Asked Questions

Why was Joli acquitted?

The reports do not give the jury’s reasons. The judge’s remark on Joli’s statements came before jurors retired, and is the only related comment reported.

Can the prosecution challenge the verdict?

Neither Defimedia nor L’Express reported any plan to challenge it. The question stays open.

World.title: Mexican Band Singer Shot at Hermosillo Show
World.content:
Mexico · Crime and Music

The lead singer of Doble Blindaje, a Mexican regional-music band, was shot at a show in Hermosillo on Wednesday 25 November 2026. Hermosillo is the capital of Sonora, the Mexican state that borders Arizona.

The attack came at about 9 p.m. local time, according to local reports, at the Legacy Men boutique, a men’s clothing shop in the Unión de Ladrilleros district, near the junction of República de Panamá and Ramón Corona streets. The band was playing at the shop’s opening.

A Mexican band’s lead singer was shot at a show in Sonora. Prosecutors are examining a possible link to his songs.

Local reports name the singer as Francisco Javier Arvayo and put his age at 23. The Sonora State Attorney General’s Office, known in Spanish as the Fiscalía, issued its statement on Thursday 26 November 2026.

The prosecutors said he was taken to hospital, where doctors reported seven gunshot wounds in different parts of his body. Officers recovered 11 spent casings of 9 mm calibre at the scene, the statement said.

Investigators from the prosecutors’ investigative agency, known as AMIC, and forensic services are working the case, the office said. It has reported no arrests so far.

Prosecutors have not confirmed a motive. They have announced no next step.

They say they are weighing a possible link between the attack and the singer’s songs. In the words of the statement, they are examining “la posible relación de los hechos con el contenido de sus interpretaciones musicales y las rivalidades entre grupos criminales”, meaning the content of his songs and rivalries between criminal groups.

Prosecutors say the band’s repertoire is dedicated to a criminal group active in the region, and that the attack may have been carried out by a rival group. That is a line of inquiry stated by the prosecutors, not a finding.

Corridos bélicos, or “war ballads”, are a genre of Mexican regional music about armed groups. Prosecutors say this band’s songs are dedicated to one such group, which is why they are examining the songs as a possible motive.

Threats against artists in the genre are not new in Hermosillo this year. On 6 September 2026 Sonora prosecutors presented a hand-written banner threatening Natanael Cano, a leading singer of Mexican regional music, by name and other regional-music artists in general terms, as evidence in a separate case.

That case concerned an attack in late August 2026 on the CUM (Centro de Usos Múltiples), a multi-use arena in Hermosillo, where armed men fired shots and burned a boxing ring. Three people were charged with homicide over the death of a man killed on 29 August 2026, whose body was found next to the banner.

Prosecutors did not accuse Cano of any crime in that case. The banner was signed by a group calling itself Grupo Bélico Mata Salas.

The prosecutors present their reading of the motive as a line of inquiry only. They stress that the investigation is continuing.

The prosecutors’ office has not announced a next step or a date for an update. Until it does, the record holds a clear count of wounds and casings, and no confirmed reason why the singer was targeted.

Who shot the singer?

Prosecutors had reported no arrests as of Thursday. They have not confirmed a motive.

Why do prosecutors link the attack to music?

They say the band’s repertoire is dedicated to a criminal group and that a rival group may be responsible. They describe this as a line of inquiry, not a conclusion.

Were there earlier threats in Hermosillo?

On 6 September 2026 prosecutors presented a threatening banner in a separate Hermosillo case. Prosecutors did not accuse Cano of any crime there.

World.title: Brazil Budget Panel Cuts US$370M in Spending
World.content:
The cut is small and may not survive: Braga says the numbers will change as amendments, sector reports and government changes arrive.

Brazil Budget

Brazil’s Congress has begun trimming the federal budget to pay for its own wish list, and the first cut is small. On Thursday, 26 November 2026, Congress’s Joint Budget Committee (CMO), which has members from both houses, approved a preliminary 2027 report that cancels R$2.09 billion (about US$370 million at R$5.68 per US$1) of government spending.

The government sent its 2027 budget bill to Congress on 31 August 2026, projecting a primary surplus of R$18.6 billion (about US$3.3 billion), meaning revenue minus spending before interest. The official target is a surplus of 0.5% of GDP, and the report says the projection comes before adjustments meant to reach it.

Lawmakers want money for their own projects. They filed 8,212 amendments worth R$286.3 billion (about US$50 billion), while the government’s bill reserved only about R$45 billion for the mandatory individual and state-delegation ones.

To pay for them, the report cuts spending across the board in a linear cut. Sector rapporteurs may steer R$1.1 billion of it to collective amendments, and the rest is split between state delegations and the general rapporteur.

More revenue does not solve it, because the R$17.6 billion (about US$3.1 billion) the committee added to the revenue forecast on Wednesday cannot be spent: the R$2.6 trillion (about US$458 billion) spending ceiling already has a destination. Only 8.3% of the R$3.4 trillion (about US$600 billion) in primary spending is discretionary, so every cut lands on a thin slice.

The national health fund carries R$658.3 million of the cancellations. Cuts may also reach the infrastructure ministry and parts of the PAC, the government’s flagship public-works plan, with ceilings of up to R$400 million (about US$70 million) for areas such as health, infrastructure and cities.

Sixteen sector rapporteurs, each covering one area such as health or infrastructure, will decide which items to cancel. A cut in one programme can be offset by amendments in the same area, so the net result for each area is not yet known.

Deputy Lindbergh Farias of the Workers’ Party (PT), the party of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, warned that cuts could hit universities. “I think the country’s big debate today should be this: how we keep the economy from entering a recession, given that the signs of slowdown are there,” he said, in the Portuguese original translated here.

Braga answered that he is committed to “extremely sensitive” programmes such as Farmácia Popular, the subsidised-pharmacy scheme, which “cannot, under any circumstances, suffer any budget cut.” Lindbergh then backed the report after Braga promised to restore R$123 million (about US$22 million) for universities and federal institutes as soon as next week.

The report also shows how much is already locked in. It sets R$209.7 billion (about US$37 billion) for investment by state companies, the largest share of it for Petrobras, the state oil giant.

The report assumes a 2027 minimum wage of R$1,741 (about US$306), which drives pension and welfare costs. Mandatory items like these make up 91.7% of primary spending, leaving the rest to investment and running the state.

Braga also used the debate to attack the cost of credit. He pointed to interest of up to 500% on revolving credit-card balances and asked why Congress does not discuss it, saying that has nothing to do with the deficit.

For investors, the cut is too small to change the fiscal picture, and the backdrop is public debt that the central bank put at 82.9% of GDP in September. The gap between the R$18.6 billion projected surplus and the 0.5%-of-GDP target is what holders of Brazilian debt in dollars will keep watching.

Braga said the cuts may change or not fully happen, because the report will be adjusted after amendments, sector reports and any government changes. The first real test comes on 1 December 2026, when the sector reports start and each area learns what it keeps.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the preliminary report?

It is the first version of the budget text, which sets limits for later stages. The final report can still change what it cuts and adds.

Will the cuts actually happen?

Not necessarily. Braga says they may change as amendments and sector reports arrive, and he has promised to restore money for priority areas.

Why does a small cut matter?

It shows how little room Congress has. Almost all spending is mandatory, so each amendment must be paid for by cancelling something else.
